MARGINS is a thoughtful and reflective design practice with a focus on culture and communities. We explore new formats in graphic design, publishing, music and food. we explicitly center intersectional perspectives and narratives, specifically the voices of women, LGBTQI+, BIPOC, disabled, working class and neurodivergent people. We put ecologically conscious thinking at the heart of our strategies. A research-led, typographic design practice. Our work spans brand identity, [spaces] motion design, and digital products. As MARGINS develops...MARGINS feels connected to environments and its people. Margins is the independent design practice of Chris Droom. As it develops, I hope this to become a co-operative group of like-minded practitioners. If you have skills in illustration, lettering, or 3d-modelling and would like to collaborate, please get in touch.
